items.prompt: ['P-N', 'P-S']: same order name across two tenants; amounts 1250/100 USD and1.005 USD. Give joint identity and exact-cent admissibility.
items.answer: tenant/order are joint; first amount has exact cents,1.005 fails amount_grid; no rounding to force admission.

items.prompt: ['P-N', 'P-S']: revision1 active 1250; revision2 missing. Another order revision2 cancelled0. What is current and why?
items.answer: Select revision first: missing/null held vs cancelled/0 known; neither resurrects revision1.

items.prompt: ['P-N', 'P-S']: W3 committed journal and receipt before process exit; sender saw no ACK. Which request/state is retried?
items.answer: Keep original state and request ID; durable original receipt and idempotent rows survive; no delete or new key.

items.prompt: An own-tenant reader requests the other ['P-N', 'P-S'] tenant; unknown principal requests all. State results and audit requirement.
items.answer: Both denied/permission_denied with empty data; retain principal/request/decision audit; admin separate.
